AML.T0051.name: LLM Prompt Injection
AML.T0051.description: Adversary crafts prompts that alter the targeted LLM's behavioral safeguards.

AML.T0054.name: LLM Jailbreak
AML.T0054.description: Adversary induces an LLM to override its safety guidelines or alignment behaviors.

AML.T0055.name: Unsecured Credentials
AML.T0055.description: Exploitation of weak credential management mechanisms or inadequately protected API keys.

AML.T0056.name: Extract LLM System Prompt
AML.T0056.description: Adversary exfiltrates or extracts the hidden system instructions governing an LLM.

AML.T0057.name: LLM Data Leakage
AML.T0057.description: Adversary crafts prompts to induce an LLM to reveal sensitive user or training data.
